title: Connect a coding agent
subtitle: A connected agent builds and updates the ontology.
previewLabel: Once connected, the agent reads it like this
step2Desc: Quit and reopen the agent you just connected. The others can stay as they are.
actionFailed: Could not connect. Press it again.
replaceCodexConfigDone: Copied · review and replace existing config.toml
deeplinkWebNote: One-click for Cursor needs the folder path.
serverLine: Atlas's MCP server is not a program that stays running. Your agent starts it on this computer only when it is needed and shuts it down with the conversation. It opens no port and makes no network request. The agent itself may talk to its own provider when you ask it to.
copiedToast: Config copied: paste it into your agent's settings to connect.
serverUnavailableTitle: The browser cannot save the config for you
serverUnavailableDesc: Your agent connects to the folder, not to Atlas: it runs the MCP server in its own session and reads and writes that folder. A browser cannot know the folder's real path, so it cannot save the config file. Enter the path and the config is built here. In the desktop app the same folder takes one button.
manualVaultLabel: ① Absolute path to your folder
manualCheckoutLabel: ② Path to your ontology-atlas source checkout
manualCheckoutHint: That is where the MCP server your agent starts lives. The desktop app includes it.
manualCloneCta: No checkout yet: copy the git clone command
manualCloneCopied: Copied · put the resulting folder path in ②
manualShapeOnlyNote: This only checks the path format: absolute, with no tilde (~) or stray quotes. It cannot tell whether this is the folder the browser opened. The test command below checks the real connection.
manualPathConfirmation: I confirm that the absolute folder path above is the same folder I opened in this browser.
manualIssueTilde: A tilde (~) is not expanded inside a config file, so it would silently fail. Use the real path (starting with /Users/…) that pwd prints in your terminal.
manualIssueRelative: An absolute path is required: start with a slash, like /Users/… (or C:\… on Windows).
manualIssueMultiline: One path only: this contains a line break.
manualFileHint: Save this as {file} in the folder you open your agent from. The path inside is absolute, so it reaches the same folder from anywhere.
manualNotReadyNote: Copying unlocks once both paths are filled in and you confirm the folder path. A config with placeholders or an unconfirmed folder does not connect, so it cannot be copied.
manualCliLabel: Prefer not to create files by hand: this one line writes the Claude Code (.mcp.json) and Codex (.codex/config.toml) configs. Missing files only; existing ones are left alone. Cursor and Antigravity read different files, so use the copy above for those.
manualRestartNote: Once saved, quit and reopen your agent: that is when it reads the new config. The test command below shows whether it connected.
copyFailed: Copy failed: the clipboard was blocked
